about: Witness notices (L18): NoticeBody {0 t, 1 aid, 2 seq, 3 head, 4 observed_at, 5 witness}, NoticeWire {1 body = coredet(NoticeBody), 2 env = aobj envelope {1 signer_aid, 2 key_state_seq, 3 alg = -8, 4 sig}}, the signature Ed25519 over the body bytes. The valid notice is the KEL-2A hub's (W2) for the tip of the KEL-2B agent's KEL up to its rot 2 (seq 2, which names W2), signed with KEL-2A k2 at key state 2. Each case gives the notice, the KEL it is checked against (subject), the hub KELs the receiver holds (hub_kels: the hub AID asked for and the KEL answered) and the arrival time; reason is what VerifyNotice must refuse it with ("" = accepted): the steps in order are 1 decoding (witness-invalid), 2 a witness to confirm (witness-missing), 3 the tip (witness-mismatch), 4 the signer (witness-invalid), 5 the witness hub's KEL and signature (witness-unknown, witness-invalid), 6 freshness (witness-stale: observed at most 6 h before the arrival and at most 5 min after it). Keys are SHA-256 of their labels: anet-golden/v016/KEL-2A/k<i>, anet-golden/v016/KEL-2B/k<i>, anet-golden/v016/KEL-2B/w1-k0 and anet-golden/v016/KSN-1/<x|y>-k<i>.
